discovery_method: background research agent over public skills/tools/MCP/plugin sources (WebSearch+WebFetch)
governance: CANDIDATES ONLY — discovery is not trust. No row here is an active capability; each must pass the seeder's gap/lift screen, then human/eval gates, before any promotion. Source URLs are as reported; license/verify_note flags carried verbatim. serves_truth=false for everything downstream.

candidates.intent: Search the US Federal Register for rules, proposed rules, notices, and executive orders by keyword, agency, and date.
candidates.input_contract: keyword query plus optional agency and date filters
candidates.output_contract: list of Federal Register documents with citations and URLs
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare LLM cannot know newly published or future-dated Federal Register documents and will hallucinate citations and effective dates.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a live, authenticated-free call to the official Federal Register API v1 returning real document numbers and URLs.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated on repo page; confirm before relying.

candidates.intent: Retrieve the current text of a Code of Federal Regulations section from the Electronic CFR.
candidates.output_contract: current regulatory text with effective date and source URL
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Regulations are amended frequently and a model's frozen weights cannot reflect the currently-in-force eCFR text.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds live retrieval of eCFR sections via the official CourtListener API v4 with verifiable source handles.
candidates.verify_note: Server bundles eCFR alongside case law; confirm eCFR endpoint coverage.

candidates.intent: Look up US federal statutes and US Code provisions for a given citation or topic.
candidates.input_contract: statute citation or legal topic query
candidates.output_contract: statutory text and metadata with source reference
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Models conflate repealed, amended, and current statutory language and invent section numbers.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds authoritative federal-statute and state privacy/breach-law retrieval grounded in government sources.
candidates.verify_note: License unverified; scope skews to privacy/breach/cybersecurity statutes.

candidates.intent: Search US federal and state court opinions and dockets for relevant case law.
candidates.output_contract: ranked court opinions with citations and links
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare LLM fabricates case names, citations, and holdings (the well-documented legal-hallucination failure mode).
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds 20+ tools over the official CourtListener API for real opinions, dockets, and citation verification.

candidates.intent: Verify that a cited case or authority actually exists and matches the quoted holding.
candidates.input_contract: a legal citation or quoted holding
candidates.output_contract: exists/not-found plus matched record and confidence
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Models routinely emit plausible but non-existent citations and cannot self-check them.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds semantic and hybrid search plus deterministic citation-existence checks against CourtListener.
candidates.verify_note: Implements CourtListener semantic-search API (Nov 2025).

candidates.intent: Search and retrieve US Congressional bills, their text, actions, and committees.
candidates.output_contract: bill details, status, actions, and full text
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Legislative status changes daily and a model cannot know a bill's current stage or latest text.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds live Congress.gov queries for real bill text, actions, and committee data.

candidates.intent: Analyze a question against free/open government legal-compliance APIs across jurisdictions.
candidates.output_contract: relevant legal documents and a structured compliance summary
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Compliance answers require current, jurisdiction-specific primary sources the model lacks and cannot cite.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds retrieval from multiple free government legal APIs so analysis is grounded in primary law.
candidates.verify_note: Compliance interpretation still needs model+human review; retrieval is the deterministic part.

candidates.intent: Find SEC EDGAR filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K) for a company and extract sections.
candidates.output_contract: matching filings with section text and SEC URLs
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot retrieve the exact current filing or its precise figures and may misquote financials.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds CIK lookup, filing retrieval, and section extraction with verifiable SEC source URLs.
candidates.verify_note: AGPL-3.0; commercial license offered separately by author.

candidates.intent: Pull XBRL-parsed balance sheet, income statement, and cash-flow figures from SEC filings.
candidates.output_contract: structured financial line items with exact values
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Models approximate financial numbers and cannot guarantee exact reported values from XBRL.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds exact-precision XBRL parsing returning audited reported figures, not estimates.
candidates.verify_note: License not confirmed on listing.

candidates.intent: Retrieve SEC Form 3/4/5 insider-transaction records for a company or insider.
candidates.output_contract: insider transactions with dates, amounts, and filing links
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Insider-transaction data is event-driven and absent from model weights.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds structured Form 3/4/5 retrieval with exact transaction values and SEC source URLs.

candidates.intent: Fetch live or recent market prices and fundamentals for a stock symbol.
candidates.output_contract: current price, fundamentals, and quote timestamp
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Live prices change by the second and a model has no real-time market access.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a direct market-data API call returning the actual current quote.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated; verify data-provider terms.

candidates.intent: Retrieve macroeconomic indicators (rates, inflation, employment) on demand.
candidates.output_contract: time-series values with source and units
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Economic series are revised and updated continuously, beyond a model's training cutoff.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds live retrieval of official economic series with explicit units and timestamps.

candidates.intent: Pull recent press releases and enforcement news from SEC, CFTC, OCC, Fed, Treasury, and FinCEN.
candidates.output_contract: recent regulator news items with links
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Regulator announcements postdate training and a model cannot surface the latest enforcement actions.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds live aggregation of official regulator press feeds with source links.

candidates.intent: Scrape a web page (including JS-rendered) and return clean Markdown.
candidates.output_contract: cleaned Markdown content of the page
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot fetch live pages or render JavaScript-heavy sites on its own.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds rendering, retries, and content extraction so the model receives clean page text.

candidates.intent: Crawl a site or section and extract structured fields across many pages.
candidates.output_contract: array of structured records per page
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Multi-page crawling, pagination, and rate-limiting are stateful operations a model cannot perform alone.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds managed crawling with concurrency and schema-driven extraction.

candidates.intent: Drive a headless browser to load a dynamic page and scrape its content.
candidates.output_contract: rendered page content as Markdown/text
candidates.gap_hypothesis: SPAs require an actual browser engine to render before any content exists to read.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds Playwright headless rendering to capture content unavailable to plain HTTP fetch.
candidates.verify_note: License inferred from Playwright (Apache-2.0); confirm wrapper license.

candidates.intent: Fetch a URL over HTTP and convert it to LLM-friendly text.
candidates.output_contract: converted page text/markdown
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model has no built-in ability to perform an outbound HTTP request.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a lightweight, official fetch tool that retrieves and converts page content.

candidates.intent: Run multi-query web research on a topic and compile a structured Markdown brief.
candidates.output_contract: structured research document with sources
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model alone cannot gather current external sources or verify them against the live web.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds Tavily search+crawl fan-out feeding the model fresh, cited source material.
candidates.verify_note: Synthesis needs the model; retrieval/fan-out is the deterministic portion.

candidates.intent: Run a web search and return ranked result snippets with URLs.
candidates.output_contract: ranked results with titles, snippets, and URLs
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model has no live index of the web and cannot return current search hits.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a Tavily-backed search call returning real, current result links.
candidates.verify_note: License not confirmed.

candidates.intent: Conduct end-to-end autonomous research across sources and produce a referenced report.
candidates.output_contract: long-form report with aggregated citations
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Sustained multi-source research with deduplication and citation tracking exceeds a single model call.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds orchestrated retrieval, source aggregation, and citation management around the model.

candidates.intent: Create a Gmail draft message (without sending) from supplied content.
candidates.output_contract: created draft id and confirmation
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot authenticate to a mailbox or persist a draft on its own.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds authenticated Gmail API access to create and manage drafts and attachments.
candidates.verify_note: Mechanics are deterministic; nuanced wording still benefits from the model.

candidates.intent: Search, read, draft, and send email across Gmail/Outlook/Yahoo via IMAP/SMTP.
candidates.output_contract: send/draft status and message references
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Mailbox access, threading, and transport are stateful operations outside a model's reach.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds provider-agnostic IMAP/SMTP send, read, and draft operations.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated; uses app passwords.

candidates.intent: Create and edit Word .docx documents programmatically.
candidates.output_contract: a generated/edited .docx file
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model emits text but cannot produce a valid binary Office file with correct structure.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic .docx construction/editing routines that guarantee valid output.
candidates.verify_note: Anthropic marks docx skill source-available (not OSS); rest of repo Apache-2.0.

candidates.intent: Create and edit Excel .xlsx workbooks with formulas and sheets.
candidates.output_contract: a generated/edited .xlsx file
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Models cannot emit a binary spreadsheet with valid formulas, cell types, and multiple sheets.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic xlsx generation with correct cell typing and formula handling.
candidates.verify_note: Source-available license per Anthropic repo.

candidates.intent: Extract text/tables from PDFs and fill PDF form fields.
candidates.input_contract: a PDF file and optional field values
candidates.output_contract: extracted content or a filled PDF
candidates.gap_hypothesis: PDFs encode layout and forms in ways a text model cannot reliably parse or write back.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic PDF parsing and form-field manipulation.
candidates.verify_note: Source-available; complex layout extraction still imperfect.

candidates.intent: Create and edit PowerPoint .pptx presentations from an outline.
candidates.output_contract: a generated/edited .pptx file
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot produce a valid binary slide deck with correct object/layout structure.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic .pptx construction from structured slide content.
candidates.verify_note: Source-available license.

candidates.intent: Search PubMed biomedical literature with full NCBI query syntax and filters.
candidates.output_contract: matching citations with PMIDs and metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot query the live 35M+ citation index or guarantee real PMIDs.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds direct NCBI/PubMed search returning verifiable citations and identifiers.

candidates.intent: Query ClinicalTrials.gov for trials matching a drug, condition, or sponsor.
candidates.output_contract: matching trial records with NCT ids
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Trial registries update continuously and a model cannot enumerate current trials or NCT ids.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds live registry queries returning real trial records and identifiers.
candidates.verify_note: Package bundles PubMed; verify ClinicalTrials.gov coverage specifically.

candidates.intent: Read, search, and inspect a Git repository's files and history.
candidates.output_contract: file contents, diffs, or search hits
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model has no filesystem or VCS access to inspect an actual repository state.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic Git read/search/manipulate operations over a real repo.

candidates.intent: Perform sandboxed file read/write/list operations within configured roots.
candidates.output_contract: file contents or operation result
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot access local files or persist outputs without a tool.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds access-controlled filesystem operations with configurable roots.

candidates.intent: Get the current time and convert between timezones.
candidates.output_contract: resolved time(s) in requested zones
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model has no clock and cannot know the current time or do reliable DST-aware conversion.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic, DST-aware time and timezone computation.

candidates.intent: Generate a reusable API skill by capturing and replaying observed web/API traffic.
candidates.output_contract: a generated callable API skill definition
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot observe network traffic or synthesize a working API client from it.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds traffic capture and deterministic skill-generation from real request/response pairs.
candidates.verify_note: OpenClaw plugin (OpenClaw = open agent framework, formerly Moltbot/Clawdbot); license unverified.

candidates.intent: Audit and harden agent skill definitions for quality and safety issues.
candidates.input_contract: a skill definition or skill pack
candidates.output_contract: audit findings and quality score
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Consistent rubric-based auditing across many skills is hard for an unstructured model pass.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a deterministic linting/validation harness for skill quality.
candidates.verify_note: OpenClaw-ecosystem tool via vincentkoc/awesome-openclaw; license unverified.

candidates.intent: Gate agent tool calls with deny-by-default policies and risk tiers.
candidates.input_contract: a proposed tool action and policy config
candidates.output_contract: allow/deny decision with risk tier
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot reliably self-enforce least-privilege gating on its own actions.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds an external deterministic policy gate with explicit risk tiers.
candidates.verify_note: OpenClaw governance plugin; license unverified.

candidates.intent: Capture tool calls, LLM usage, and lifecycle events with tamper-proof hash chains.
candidates.output_contract: redacted, hash-chained event log
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot observe or tamper-proof its own execution trace.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic event capture with redaction and hash-chained integrity.
candidates.verify_note: Listed in awesome-openclaw; exact repo/license unverified, linking to the curated list.

candidates.intent: Provide reusable, test-driven engineering skills for coding agents.
candidates.input_contract: a coding task matching a skill
candidates.output_contract: structured skill instructions/workflow
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model lacks consistent, repeatable engineering methodology across tasks.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a community-maintained, structured skills library for systematic execution.
candidates.verify_note: Accepted into Anthropic Claude Code marketplace; license to confirm.

candidates.intent: Extend an LLM UI with custom tools that fetch real-world/real-time data.
candidates.output_contract: a callable tool exposed to the model
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model in a chat UI cannot reach external systems without an installed tool.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a plugin framework that exposes real-time data/actions to the model.
candidates.verify_note: Used as a verified substitute for harder-to-confirm plugin ecosystems; license per Open WebUI project.

candidates.intent: Install marketplace plugins (tools/models/extensions) into an agent app.
candidates.input_contract: a Dify plugin package or selection
candidates.output_contract: an installed tool/model usable in workflows
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot acquire new tool capabilities at runtime without a plugin system.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a marketplace of deterministic tools/extensions an agent app can mount.
candidates.verify_note: Dify uses a modified OSS license (not pure OSS); confirm before redistribution.

candidates.intent: Search Yahoo Finance news for a company or ticker.
candidates.output_contract: recent finance news items
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot retrieve current financial news beyond its training cutoff.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a live finance-news retrieval tool returning current articles.
candidates.verify_note: langchain-community is being sunset/no longer maintained; treat as legacy candidate.

candidates.intent: Query financialdatasets.ai for company fundamentals and market data.
candidates.output_contract: structured financial dataset rows
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot pull structured, current fundamentals on demand.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a typed toolkit returning structured financial data from a live API.
candidates.verify_note: Hosted in the now-sunset langchain-community package; verify maintenance.
